newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian official reserves rise in February.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian official reserves rise in February.

text.p: Australia's holdings of gold and foreign exchange assets rose to US$16.822 billion in February from US$16.758 billion in January, compared with US$14.163 billion in February 1996, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
In Australian dollar terms, reserves fell by A$309 million to A$21.683 billion in February from A$21.992 billion in January compared with A$18.550 billion a year earlier, the bank said.
The bank said this was mainly due to valuation effects associated with the rise in the Australian dollar over the month.
